_readme: Owner-maintained inputs for scripts/prevention_impact.py. This file is
hand-edited; data/prevention_impact.json is generated and never edited.
Every entry under `parameters` carries a `source` and a `verified` flag.
`verified: false` means nobody has opened the primary document and
confirmed the number. The script REFUSES to mark a headline figure
publishable while any parameter it depends on is unverified. That is the
whole point: an uncited assumption should block the claim, not decorate it.
`periods` below is EXAMPLE DATA so the pipeline runs end to end. It
describes no real engagement. Replace it with the real service log before

business.program: Elder fraud prevention — awareness and action

population_60plus.source: US Census Bureau population estimates, ages 60+ (~78M, 2023-2024)
population_60plus.note: Denominator for the national-consistency constraint only. Does not scale the local estimate.

national_annual_loss_low.note: FTC 2024 low-end estimate of true (underreporting-adjusted) fraud cost to adults 60+.

national_annual_loss_high.note: FTC 2024 high-end estimate. The 8x span between low and high is the honest state of the evidence, not a rounding choice.

loss_median_usd.source: FTC Consumer Sentinel 2024: median reported individual loss exceeding $1,600 for adults 80+
loss_median_usd.note: MEDIAN, not mean. Reported medians understate true medians because small losses go unreported; the upper leg of the PERT carries that.

loss_sigma_log.source: Implied by FTC median (~$1,600) vs FBI IC3 2024 mean (~$83,000) for 60+ under a lognormal: sigma = sqrt(2*ln(mean/median)) ~ 2.81
loss_sigma_log.note: Two independent sources reconcile at sigma ~ 2.8, which is why this shape is used rather than assumed. Populations differ (IC3 is internet-crime complainants, FTC is all fraud), so the mode is an anchor, not a fit.

annual_incidence_60plus.unit: money-losing fraud events per person per year
annual_incidence_60plus.source: DERIVED — no single citable figure. Prior is deliberately wide and is then constrained by `national_consistency` below.
annual_incidence_60plus.note: Do not tighten this by hand. The national-consistency filter tightens it from published aggregates, which is auditable; a hand-picked value is not.

rrr_intensive.source: Langton & DeLiema, Journal of Consumer Affairs (2026), USPIS 'Fraud Fighter' RCT, N=2253: 22% relative reduction in revictimization risk (5 percentage points absolute, p=0.029). https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/joca.70059
rrr_intensive.note: TRANSFER ASSUMPTION. The RCT measured a mailed campaign to prior mail-fraud victims. An in-person program with follow-up is a different dose to a different population; the mode is set AT the RCT point estimate rather than above it, so the transfer does not smuggle in optimism.

rrr_standard.source: Scaled below rrr_intensive; no direct RCT for a single-session dose.
rrr_standard.note: Dose-response is assumed monotone, not measured. This is a named weakness, not a hidden one.

rrr_brief.source: Lower bound pinned at ZERO — a table at a health fair may change nothing.
rrr_brief.note: A prior whose lower bound excludes zero asserts the program works. This one does not assert that.

persistence_half_life_months.source: DERIVED — awareness decay is not directly measured in the elder-fraud literature.
persistence_half_life_months.note: Protection is not permanent. Without decay the model credits a 2019 seminar for a 2026 save, which is how these estimates become fiction.

recovery_absent_intervention.source: DERIVED — bank clawback / wire recall rates vary by rail and speed.
recovery_absent_intervention.note: SUBTRACTED from every interdiction. Money the bank would have reversed anyway was not prevented by Christian. Omitting this term is the single most common way interdiction tallies get inflated.

stage_loss_probability._source: DERIVED — stage-conditional completion priors. Not measured; elicited. Treat as the weakest link in the interdiction channel.

evidence_weight._source: Policy choice, not an empirical quantity. Discounts cases nobody can corroborate.

note: Rejection-sampling constraint. A draw of (annual_incidence_60plus, loss_median_usd,
loss_sigma_log) implies a national annual loss to adults 60+ of
Draws implying a total outside the FTC's published $10.1B-$81.5B range are
discarded. This is what keeps a local estimate tethered to national data:
any parameter set that would only make sense in a country losing $400B a
year to elder fraud is not allowed to price Christian's month.

intensive.description: Multi-session engagement or ongoing household monitoring: account alerts configured, trusted-contact designations filed, follow-up contact.

standard.description: One full awareness session (45+ min) with take-home materials and a named follow-up channel.

brief.description: Short-form exposure: expo table, radio segment, single handout. No verified comprehension.
